shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && cat app/layout.tsx && cat app/page.tsx'

/bin/bash -lc "cat components/request-metadata.tsx && cat tsconfig.json && rg -n \"dynamic|force-|cacheComponents|connection\\(|cookies\\(|headers\\(|Math.random|Date|request\" app components next.config.ts package.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json && git ls-files && ls -la | head -35 && cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && rg -n \"export const dynamic|force-dynamic|force-static|revalidate\\s*=\" app components next.config.ts || true"
